notes: Seam suffix _L / _R = the wearer's left (+x) / right (-x). The alignment puts the pattern's own blocks ('A - Skirt Front', 'A - Skirt Back') on -x and their mirrors (Skirt_Front_R, Skirt_Back_R) on +x. The job (assert/jobs/aldrich_skirt.json) has only the two skirt blocks: no waistband, facing or zip piece, so the waist edge is left free. The darts are not cut into the outline: each is sewn along its legs from the waist (dart-cap points on the outline) to its apex (an interior named point).
